then.say: Out of the way of the buckets, love. Hedda. I carry the water, so I hear everything. Wells are for talking at.
A carter swears one wall in the Tallow Stores breathes warm air. Says there's something behind it. Put your shoulder to it, if you're ever down there.
The old lift by the fire runs down into the Works. Its lever's at the bottom. Pull it and you'd come and go as you please.
There's a sluice deep in the Waxmire. Open it and it drains a way into the Abbey's Undercroft. The monks used it to carry out the dead.

else.say: Pilgrims hide shards of their phials in chests on the road. The glass remembers what it held. Bring the shards to the shrine.

do.say: The poster? Order's looking for a hooded convict. Can't think who they mean.
Nobody here reads, love. Nobody here tells.
Don't drink the mire water. I mean it.
